tools.name: search_paint_colors
tools.description: Find paint colours by name or code across all brands, e.g. "Hague Blue", "SW 7029", "agreeable gray", "grün". Matching ignores case and accents ("sniezny" finds "Śnieżny") and every word may be a prefix. Optionally restrict to one brand. Returns name, brand, code, hex, LRV (light reflectance, 0 = bl

tools.name: get_paint_color
tools.description: Look up one paint colour by brand and exact name or code, e.g. brand "Sherwin-Williams" + "SW 7029" or "Agreeable Gray"; brand "Farrow & Ball" + "Hague Blue" or "30". Case, spacing and accents are ignored. A brand sold in several markets (Dulux UK/PL, Sikkens NL/DE/IT, Beckers SE/PL) may return one

tools.name: find_equivalents
tools.description: Find the closest colours in OTHER brands to a given paint colour or hex value, e.g. "Behr equivalent of Farrow & Ball Hague Blue" or "which Benjamin Moore is closest to #D1CBC1". Give either brand + name_or_code, or hex. Distance is CIEDE2000 ΔE with a verdict: under 1 practically identical, under 2

tools.name: list_brands
tools.description: List the paint brands in the database with their number of colours and a brand page url. With country (ISO code like "DE", "PL", "US", "GB" or a name like "Germany"), returns the brands sold there in order of local relevance.

tools.name: get_credits
tools.description: Paid tools only. Show the Muro credit balance and plan of the connected account. Painting costs 1 credit per colour in Standard, 2 in HD and 3 in Ultra.

tools.name: visualize_room
tools.description: Paid (Muro credits, needs a Muro API key). Repaint the walls in a photo of a room, facade or roof in 1 to 12 colours at once and return one image per colour. Give the photo as image_url (a public link) or image_base64. Give each colour as brand + name_or_code from the catalogue (e.g. "Farrow & Ball"

tools.name: get_visualization
tools.description: Paid tools. Fetch the colours of a visualize_room job that were not ready yet, by job_id and project_id. Waits up to about 25 seconds. Costs nothing extra.

tools.name: relight_room
tools.description: Paid (like one colour in the quality it was painted in: 1 credit standard, 2 hd, 3 ultra). Relight a finished interior visualization as day, evening or night, with lamps on or off, keeping the wall colour. Needs project_id and the color_key returned by visualize_room.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "visualize_room" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Paid (Muro credits, needs a Muro API key). Repaint the walls in a photo of a room, facade or roof in 1 to 12 colours at once and return one image per colour. Gi…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
